summary: Bumble Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiaries entered into a $475 million Term Loan Credit Agreement on April 24, 2026. The facility matures April 24, 2030, amortizes at 12.5%-15% annually, and bears interest at Base Rate +7.00% or Term SOFR +8.00%. Mandatory prepayments and a make-whole premium for early repayment within two years are included, with a prepayment penalty thereafter. The financing increases leverage, likely to fund corporate purposes or refinance existing debt. Watch for impacts on free cash flow and potential covenant constraints.
